Now in a nutshell, what's been your message here to the participants at this Planet

The message from Malawi is simple.
Let us, as a world-based global, let us all coordinate and cooperate.
Let us make sure that ICD programs are encouraged within the ITU, the master plan.
Let us encourage those that have been elected, congratulations for the Secretary and the
entire management.
And we think that Malawi is going to benefit from the new executive.
They have already done a good work to Malawi.
We Malawi, as a member state, is proud to be part of ITU.
And we believe that the Secretary and his team will continue helping Malawi as a developing
country and as a developing economy.
And we sincerely thank them for their contribution.
We look forward to more contributions from both ITU and Malawi as a country.
